'''Taarna Renay''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] who often worked out of [[Point Nadir]]. She frequented the [[Under the Table]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]], where she would make contacts for new jobs.<ref name="Scum and Villainy" />

Renay was a very prolific smuggler, and would carry any cargo with a minimum amount of questions. She had a co-[[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] named [[Polien Frue]]. She was fast, carried a blaster on her hip and was known to fight dirty when she needed to.<ref name="Scum and Villainy" />

Dressed in the fashion of a [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Scoundrel/Legends|scoundrel]], Renay wore tight black pants, knee-high boots, a collared shirt, and a black leather vest.<ref name="Scum and Villainy" />
